harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Draft of 2026-11-22, written before any game in these worlds was played. Pilot (RULES 16): 5 arms in patches-x8, classes-18
(90 games); the arms that lead go to verysmall after the gate and the owner. Games compare only within the world; ctl is
the control.
Gate: no config_error; one binary; every cell's config.txt has borg_world and the same borg_world_data_sha256 within a
world; each arm's values in params-core.json and its scary list copy (the borg_scary_list_lines applied); every cell ends
in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; frozen-turn bursts classified; death bundles reproduced (in the world).
Report per world, arm and class: deaths and causes; patch deaths (killer the grey mushroom patch, or any killer while
confused next to a patch); CL and DL at death, max CL and DL; paired rescued and newly killed against ctl (exact
McNemar); identical plays. Per game: grey mushroom patches met ("# Creating a monster 'grey mushroom patch'"),
killed, and confused turns next to one; "# Attack on sight: grey mushroom patch" and "# Not fixing Confusion next to an
immobile confuser" notes; CLW quaffed while confused. Check that the world does what it says: patches met per game in x4
and x8 against the normal-world baseline at 9085c266 (run 45028029063, same Borg). A world is a stress test: a policy
that wins here still needs the normal world's measurement before a shipped value changes.
